description: Pendulum swinging alongside a static floor, illustrating how rigid body physics interacts with a ground plane.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_physics import *

class PendulumWithGravity(SpaceScene):
    def construct(self):
        floor = Line([-5, -3, 0], [5, -3, 0])
        self.add(floor)
        self.make_static_body(floor)
        p = Pendulum(length=2.5, initial_theta=0.4, pivot_point=UP * 1.5)
        self.add(p)
        self.make_rigid_body(*p.bobs)
        p.start_swinging()
        self.wait(2)
